{{Quote|This Allya was a rogue Jedi, the Old Republic did not want to execute her, so the Jedi exiled her, hoping that given time she would turn away from the dark side.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="COPL" />}}
'''Allya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. She was expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and exiled to a [[Prison/Legends|penal colony]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Encountering the other former exiles, she used the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] strong life energy to teach the colony's [[Gender/Legends|women]] to master [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. These women became the [[Witches of Dathomir]] and Allya was their founder.<ref name="EPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>

==Biography==
{{Quote|Allya held the favor of the spirits, and her daughters became the first crafters of spirit-willed magicks.|[[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Allya was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the early [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]<ref name="COPL" /> of an era known to later [[Historian/Legends|historians]] as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="CSWEgpr">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> She was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|keenly attuned]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="COPL" /> a natural yet mystical energy field that bound [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] together.<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> She attracted the attention of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="COPL" /> the members of which [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the use of the Force and acted as the guardians of justice and peace in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AGTSWU2" /> Allya eventually attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. However, around [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]], she was seduced by the "[[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]" of the Force,<ref name="COPL" /> which granted quicker access to power and strength but was filled with aggression, fear, and anger.<ref name="AGTSWU2" /> By turning away from the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], Allya had become a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], and her fate fell into the hands of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the primary organizational body of the Order.<ref name="NEC" /> Because the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] prescribed to respect all life,<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Scrapbook]]''</ref> the Council members were reluctant to execute offenders. Therefore, they decided to [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] the rogue Allya, hoping that primitive isolation would force her to reflect on her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters']] teachings and return to the light.<ref name="NEC" /> Since the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], with its savage and rugged forests, had long served as a [[Prison/Legends|penal colony]] for some of the Galactic Republic's worst criminals, the Council chose to banish her there.<ref name="EPM" /><ref name="EC" /><ref name="NEC" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Upon her arrival at Dathomir, Allya discovered the planet's inhabitants who were the descendants of [[Human/Legends|Human]] warriors and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] incarcerated by the extinct [[Paecian Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="COPL" /> Allya used the Force to tame feral [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] and subjugate the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], as well as any other desperate life forms.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="JVS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Once in command, she established a matriarchal society with a genetic Force component and where men had little to no power.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="JVS" /> In time, Allya had many daughters and taught each one, along with other women, the ways of the Force.

This new society, filled with clans of female rancor tamers who used totems and incantations to generate their "[[Dathomir Magic|magic]]," became known as the Witches of Dathomir.<ref name="TEA" /> It was not until the birth of her granddaughters that Allya saw the error of her ways: she had turned her own sons into slaves and taught her daughters how to use the Force to achieve power. Using her strong influence over her offsprings, she spent the rest of her days instructing her daughters in the ways of the light side.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> Before her [[Death/Legends|death]], to ensure her daughters practiced their magic in a safe and sane manner, Allya wrote [[Book of Law/Legends|''The Book of Law'']], which she based off of the Jedi Code.<ref name="JVS" /> The Witches of Dathomir never learned that the magic they used was actually the Force.

==Legacy==
[[File:Daughters-of-allya.png|thumb|The daughters of Allya]]
Despite her death, Allya's society and unique culture survived well into the modern eras<ref name="TEA" /> governed by ''The Book of Law.''<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Her descendants would share her story with their daughters for generations.

On their very first visit to Dathomir in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], witch [[Teneniel Djo]] told Allya's story to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Hapan]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]].<ref name="COPL" /> [[36 ABY|Twenty-eight years later]], Teneniel and Isolder's granddaughter, [[Chume'da]] [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], would become Allya's partial namesake.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/23110149|board=Authors and Artists|thread=The Official Troy Denning Discussion Thread|user=[[Troy Denning|Tailone]]|date=2006-02-08|time=8:55 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160527205809/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-troy-denning-discussion-thread.5816786/page-27}}</ref>
